newsitem.title: ISRAEL: ANZ Bank East Jerusalem branch approved.
newsitem.headline: ANZ Bank East Jerusalem branch approved.

text.p: Australia and New Zealand (ANZ) Banking Group has been given permission to open a branch in Arab East Jerusalem, a Bank of Israel spokesman said on Monday.
The branch is expected to formally open in April.
The spokesman said the license was for a single branch but added that ANZ should be able to obtain permission for additional branches.
"Our policy is that if as serious bank wants to open branches in our country, we will approve it," he said.
Several foreign investment banks have opened offices in Tel Aviv in the last two years but no commercial bank has set up operations in Israel.
An ANZ spokesman in London confirmed the bank's plan but could provide no further details.
